ordered_prerequisites: A field whose phase-1 join coverage clears 0.60 AND whose matched population is not selected by consumption. Neither measured field qualifies: local ceilings at 0.126468 and alt at 0.273512, and both show ~3.5x consumption enrichment through the event_id_echo tier.
Phase 2 ships a grade report on that field — calibrated threshold, measured noise floor, importer-valid per-event verdict JSONL — and mints the method_version V.
Phase 3's ledger is deployed and fed with rows for (F, V), which requires the operator deploy + restart described in artifacts/transcript-grounding/ledger/deploy-handoff.md.
Phase 4 then executes this prereg as written: eval buckets 6-7 decide and are committed first, holdout buckets 8-9 confirm afterwards.
Only a 'positive' on both stages licenses a phase-5 valve, default-off, limited to the retrieval-weight channel.
what_would_reopen_phases_4_and_5.the_idea_is_still_not_refuted: Nothing in either field's measurement tests whether transcript-grounded silent-recall reinforcement helps. The blocker sits upstream of the hypothesis: the only mechanism that links a recall event to its transcript is the echo of its id, and that echo is largely written by the consumption event the signal was meant to replace.
